review_locator: PMCID:PMC12358479, Krüppel-like factor 4 control of immune cell function
decision_basis: The review identifies Arg1 as a KLF4/STAT6-cooperative alternative-macrophage output and the cited primary demonstrates KLF4 recruitment to the Arg1 enhancer with WT versus ΔKLF/ΔSTAT6 reporter dependence and KLF4/STAT6-dependent Arg1 expression changes.
limitations_preserved: KLF4 recruitment and reporter activity support a bounded macrophage KLF4-to-ARG1 gene bridge, but activation is STAT6/cofactor-dependent; distinguish ARG1 transcript from ARG1 protein/enzymatic output and do not infer SCI or terminal-TF output.
